name: Leave Party (Horde)
description: Make NPC(s) leave the player's Horde party.
note: Needs Horde and Mantella - Horde Followers. Use this instead of Mantella's Unfollow action; enable only one of the two.
prompt: If the player tells you to stop following them, go home or leave their party, or you decide to leave the party yourself, begin your response with '{key}:'
